definitions.definition: (by extension) used as a term of address for one's wife

quote.text: (spoken by the father) I don't share it with mom! Right, mom?

definitions.definition: (Canada, South Africa, US, West Midlands, colloquial, informal) Mother.
(informal) An adult female owner of a pet.
(transitive, Canada, US, informal) To care for in a motherly way.

quote.text: The shock of my news had worn off, and now she'd want to know where I was, how I was doing, and she'd sniff out that I was with someone. “I just wanted to check in on you.” That was Mom. Totally unashamed about momming me.
He tried to tell me how to live, to mom me, I told him fuck off,  […]
